task_input_descriptions.planner:
Task video description:
An underwater scene shows a scuba diver in a bright yellow-green top and dark fins swimming horizontally across the upper left of the frame, releasing a vertical stream of bubbles, while the camera tracks a vast, sloping coral reef that dominates the lower two-thirds of the view. The reef is densely packed with varied coral formations in shades of pale green, tan, and white, including branching and boulder-like structures, set against a deep blue water background that darkens toward the top. The diver moves from the left edge toward the center-left, changing from a horizontal to a more vertical orientation as they descend slightly, while the camera pans slowly to the right, revealing more of the extensive, textured coral slope.
